verdict.rationale: Gusto's evidence pack shows an MCP dev-assistant server for developers building on the API and standard payroll/HR features, but there is no evidence of AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced to end users from their own payroll/HR data (e.g., analytics, recommendations, anomaly detection). Missing for 10: any in-product AI insight/suggestion feature, evidence of AI analyzing user data and returning recommendations, or documentation of such a capability.
